title: Grateful Dead Live at Eagle's Auditorium on 1968-09-20

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of the 9/20/68 Berkeley show captures clear stage banter and strong drum work, but the musical performance is only moderately engaging.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is praised for its clarity—stage chatter comes through cleanly and the overall tape quality is decent for a late‑1968 source. Musically the set is highlighted by an extended Drums segment and a solid St. Stephen that mirrors the Aoxomoxoa sessions, yet many reviewers note a lack of fire compared to the hotter August shows, describing the Eleven as shorter and less energetic.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average to below‑average (energy low, some songs noted as weak) while recording quality is good; the weighted combination yields a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear stage banter and generally decent fidelity for the era; no major dropouts reported, though some reviewers give a modest 3‑star personal quality assessment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical late‑summer set with extended drum improvisation; transitions are serviceable but the overall energy feels subdued compared to peak shows of the period.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal laughter is noted and a strange vibrating guitar part (likely his) appears during St. Stephen.
band_member_comments.Drums: Long (≈25 min) drum segment featuring Vince Delgado and Shankar Ghosh; praised by drum enthusiasts despite being described as not especially interesting.
